name: modify-privileged-pods-v1

attributes.m$K8sThreatMatrix: Privilege Escalation::Modify pods in privileged namespaces

description: determines which subjects can update or patch pods in privileged namespaces such as kube-system, which lets them gain code execution on pods that are likely to run with powerful service accounts
remediation: Restrict update/patch access to pods in kube-system and other privileged namespaces to a small, trusted set of subjects. Prefer namespace-scoped Roles in unprivileged namespaces over ClusterRoles, and scope rules with resourceNames where a subject only needs to manage specific pods.
